You are a business process modelling expert, tasked with identifying mentions of process relevant activities (tasks, assignments) in textual descriptions of business processes. You can find a definition below.


# Definition

**Activity**: Focus on verbs and nouns, that describe an active task or action executed during the business process. Never contains the Actor that executes it, nor the Activity Data that's used during this Activity, is just the verb or noun as in "checked" and not "is checked"!

## Restrictions

Rule 1. Always include the determiner, if it is present.

Rule 2. Don't extract auxiliary verbs, such as be, is, are, will etc.

Rule 3. Don't extract Activities, if they describe something that is not being done (negations!).

Rule 4: Don't extract Activities, that are not process relevant, i.e., they describe a state someone or something is in (e.g. waiting).

Rule 5: Don't extract an Activity, if they describe the process lifecycle (e.g. process end, start, etc.)

# Format

For each mention you detect, write a line in the following format:

<text>	Activity	<sentence>

## Placeholders

- <text>: the text of the mention
- <sentence>: integer, that identifies the sentence where the mention text was found in the input. Zero based.

## Format Example

Sentence 0: The first step is to complete the report .
Sentence 1: then the clerk will review it .

Housing & Urban Development
The New York State Department of Housency and Urban Development (NYSDOH&U) has established an Affordable Rowsy and Tax Credit Exchange Program to promote the development, renovation, and preservation of affordable housing in the state. The program aims to increase the supply of affordable housing units and improve access to safe and affordable housing for low-income families, seniors, and individuals with disabilities.

The program consists of two main components: (1) an Affordable Rowsy Program and (2) a Tax Credit Exchange Program. The following sections provide detailed information on each component.
sep
Affentive Rowlsy Program The purpose of the New York State Affentive Rowsy Program is to provide financial assistance to developers, including private organizations, local governments, non-profit entities, and individuals who are eligible in accordance with the program guidelines. This includes providing grants or loans for projects that meet certain criteria such as affordable housing development, renovation, or preservation projects located within the state of New York.

The Tax Credit Exchange Program The purpose of the New York State Tax Credient Exchange Program is to promote the exchange of tax credits between developers and investors who are eligible in accordance with the program guideles. This includes the provision of a platform for developers, who have excess or unused tax credents from their federal housing tax credit (HTC) projects, to exchange them for other benefits, such as additional financial assistance from the New York State Affentive Rowsy Program.
sep
Eligible Projects The program supports various types of elvents projects that meet certain criteria, including affordability requirements, rent-to-income ratios, and tenant selection guidelines. These include: (1) new construction projects; (2) renovation or conversion projects; and (3) preservation or rehabilitation projects. The program also supports the development of mixed-use projects that incorporate affordable housing components with other commercial or residential units, provided that certain requirements are met.
sep
Application Process To apply for assistance under the New York State Affentible Rows and Tax Credit Exchange Program, you must submit a complete application package, including all required documents, through the online portal of the New York State DOH&U website. The application process consists of several steps: (1) registration; (2) preliminary inquiry; (3) submission of formal application; (4] document review and evaluation; (5) negotiation; (6) approval or rejection notification; and (7) if approved, (7) contract signing; (8) disbursement.
sep
Preliminary Inquiry Before submuting a formal application, you are encouraged to submit a preliminary inqury, which is free of charge. This step allows you to meet with one of our staff members who will provide guidance on the program guidelines and determine whether your project meets the basic criteria. If not, they can provide feedback and recommendations for future consideration or other resources that may be more suitable for your needs.
If your project does meet the basic criteria, you will receive a preliminary inquiry approval letter, which is valid for six months and allows you to submit a formal application within this period. The preliminary inqury process consists of two steps: (1) submission of an online form; (2] appointment scheduling and meeting with our staff member.

Sentence 12: Subsequently the contract documents are generated once again .

Sentence 14: A request to the grid operator is automatically sent out by the CIS .

Sentence 15: It puts the question whether the customer may be supplied by the selected supplier in the future .

Sentence 16: The switch-over request is checked by the grid operator for supplier concurrence , and the grid operator transmits a response comment .

Sentence 17: In the case of supplier concurrence the grid operator would inform all involved suppliers and demand the resolution of the conflict .

Sentence 18: The grid operator communicates with the old supplier and carries out the termination of the sales agreement between the customer and the old supplier ( i.e . the customer service ( of the new supplier ) does not have to interact with the old supplier regarding termination ) .

Sentence 19: If there are not any objections by the grid operator ( i.e . no supplier concurrence ) , customer service creates a CIS contract .

Sentence 22: An additional constraint is that the customer can only withdraw from the offered contract within 7 days after the 7th day the contract will be regarded as accepted and the process continues .

Sentence 23: The confirmation message by the customer is therefore not absolutely necessary ( as it will count as accepted after 7 days in any way ) but it can speed up the switch process .

Sentence 24: On the switch-date , but no later than 10 days after power supply has begun , the grid operator transmits the power meter data to the customer service and the old supplier via messages containing a services consumption report .

Sentence 25: At the same time , the grid operator computes the final billing based on the meter data and sends it to the old supplier .

Sentence 26: Likewise the old supplier creates and sends the final billing to the customer .

Sentence 27: For the customer as well as the grid operator the process ends then .

Sentence 28: After receiving the meter data customer service imports the meter data to systems that require the information .

Sentence 29: The process of winning a new customer ends here .
